The mattress has a patterned cover with a mix of brown and beige tones, complementing the dark wood. The headboard is white with a textured design that adds a decorative element to the room. To the left of the bed, there is a tall, narrow wardrobe with a mirror on top, reflecting part of the room. Below the mirror, there are two drawers for storage.
